title: 7.6 What I Like to Do
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Say which activities you like, ask a friend about theirs, and discover a shared interest.
grammar_function: Explicit I like to preferences and Do you like to questions with eight activities; pictures identify an activity, never a hidden opinion.
prerequisite: 1.2 reading; 1.3 swimming; 1.7 playing; 5.5 like and do not like.
speaking_outcome: Say which activities you like, ask a friend about theirs, and discover a shared interest.
